# Champion Footballer

> Champion Footballer is your ultimate hub for football management, tracking player stats, match creation, leaderboards, and rewards.

## Core Features
- [Player Card Creation](https://championfootballer.co.uk/)
- [Leagues and Matches](https://championfootballer.co.uk/all-leagues)
- [World Ranking and Stats](https://championfootballer.co.uk/world-ranking)
- [Trophies and Rewards](https://championfootballer.co.uk/rewards)
